description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the performance of three different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, and Github files—across a range of token counts. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," spans from 200 to 900 with a linear scale, marked at intervals of 200. The y-axis represents the performance metric, ranging from 10 to 40 in increments of 10. The data for Tutorials is shown by a blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 23 at 200 tokens and increasing to about 29 at 800 tokens before slightly decreasing to around 28 at 900 tokens. The Library Documentation is represented by a red line with circular markers, beginning at roughly 26 at 200 tokens, rising to a peak of about 32 at 800 tokens, and then declining to approximately 27 at 900 tokens. The Github files are depicted by a green line with circular markers, starting at around 28 at 200 tokens, increasing to about 33 at 800 tokens, and then slightly decreasing to approximately 30 at 900 tokens. The yellow line, which appears to represent a fourth category, starts at about 33 at 200 tokens and shows a steady decline to around 12 at 900 tokens. The plot suggests that the performance of Tutorials and Library Documentation generally increases with the number of tokens, while the performance of Github files peaks around 800 tokens and then declines. The yellow line shows a consistent decrease in performance as the number of tokens increases.
